entry.title: New: dsh-minimax-usage#trusted-plugin
entry.summary: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT. Exact install spec: @floatingdeaming/minimax-usage. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
